children: (BUILT + PROVEN + PERSISTED 2026-07-22, cairn) a — the standard surface machinery in BaseShim: a device DECLARES its panes and provides handlers; BaseShim assembles the ACTIVE payload as structured DATA (extending introspect(): intention/state/settings/other -> the pane set). Surfaces are a declared LIST, not a fixed enum; STATUS+SETTINGS are the floor, the rest declared, multiples allowed. LANDED: BaseDevice.declared_panes() (default [], the offered extras with handlers) + BaseShim.active_page() (the standard assembly — STATUS+SETTINGS projected from introspect(), declared panes appended in order, multiples allowed, an unwired or raising handler renders ABSENT-with-reason not fatal (CP2/Law 7), the whole page json-round-trips so it is DATA not HTML). Proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_active_page.py (5 teeth), green under the tester, VALIDATION persisted beside-code at cairn/tools/base/validations/test_active_page.json. FILED EDGE: STATUS carries only the REPORTED intention; the reported-vs-filed DRIFT comparison is child b's render-time job (it reads disk intentions), not the shim's.

(BUILT + PROVEN + PERSISTED 2026-07-22, cairn) b — the web_server device: a standing daemon (launched via launchers/, instance at ~/.cairn/devices/web_server/0/), owning its listening PORT (Law 6). A dumb HTTP<->bus bridge: browser <-> HTTP <-> web_server <-> bus <-> each device's shim. Renders the standard panes' DATA to HTML (interaction panes may bring their own view). v0: bind LOCALHOST, single operator (Akien) — it exposes device internals and (later) a kill switch. Python stdlib http.server; no framework unless a real need pulls one. LANDED: cairn/devices/web_server/ — render.py (pure data->html, everything a device says HTML-escaped), server.py (WebServerDevice.serve(path)->(status,ctype,html), reaching each device's active_page live THROUGH the ground_loop that beats it — in-process v0, the bus request/reply transport FILED), daemon.py (the thin http.server localhost wrapper, smoke-tested binding+serving, kept out of the proof as the unprovable-without-OS piece). Proof test_web_server.py (6 teeth: nav-is-roster, panes render, coherent-404-still-shows-nav, device-strings-escaped, absent-pane-reason, owns-no-state), green under the tester, VALIDATION at cairn/devices/web_server/validations/test_web_server.json. ground_loop gained shim_for(id) (a read accessor — reach a device THROUGH the heartbeat that holds it). Charter cairn/devices/web_server/intention+why.json. Filed edges carried: the bus transport, reported-vs-filed drift on STATUS, rich interaction views, and the launcher wiring the REAL running heartbeat (daemon.py stubs an empty one today).

(BUILT + PROVEN + PERSISTED 2026-07-22, cairn) c — ground_loop contracted to publish the live heartbeat ROSTER (the devices it beats to) at all times; that roster IS the nav across the top. Extends the heartbeat's existing knowledge of its subscribers — no new owner. LANDED: GroundLoopDevice.roster() returns {beats, devices:[{device, awake}]} — the subscription list in order, each with live wakefulness (its shim's running), published at all times (before the first beat too); a device absent from subscriptions is absent from the nav; DATA the web server renders. Proven as a tooth in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_ground_loop.py, green under the tester, VALIDATION persisted beside-code at cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/validations/test_ground_loop.json. No new owner — it is the subscription list ground_loop already owns (Law 6).

(BUILT + PROVEN + PERSISTED 2026-07-24, cairn) d — the VOYAGE pane / ⚓ Harbor route: renders harbor_master's TRAFFIC IMAGE (harbor-master child c) — the whole-fleet, state-right-now view — as a fleet-wide route, distinct from the per-device pages. LANDED: render.render_traffic_image (pure data->html, calm-when-healthy: each emergent gate's underway COUNT + its flagged boats as readable lines, every boat-derived string escaped) + the /harbor route in server.serve (harbor source INJECTED, not imported — the data/render split holds; a surface with none says so with a coherent 404) + the ⚓ Harbor link in render_nav on every page. Proof cairn/devices/web_server/proofs/test_voyage_pane.py (4 teeth, sealed under a real netns), VALIDATION beside-code. This cashes out the map's Events-vs-Voyages split's Voyages side (cross-device/fleet), rendered from harbor_master, the device that owns the register+voyages (the 'artifact-owner' this waited on, now real). Because the traffic image is disk-computed, /harbor renders the REAL fleet from a bare daemon TODAY — the first live human-visible Cairn surface (Telos 2). The LOGGING pane (per-device Events) remains a later surface; a device may still declare its own ticket view via the same machinery.

(deferred, waits on the cgroup-kill sudo script) e — the SETTINGS pane's CIRCUIT BREAKER: the web server presents the button; the halt travels the bus to the device's shim, which kills the device's cgroup subtree (cgroup v2 cgroup.kill — inescapable by forking/re-parenting, the likely cause of past failed kills) via a narrow least-privilege sudo script (sudo-relay pattern). Presentation describes; the owner runs; the kill is physics (Law 4).
